response.justification: While Bogdan is clearly an accomplished software engineer with strong fundamentals, IDE experience, and proven ability to work on complex systems, he lacks the required deep expertise in Java and Kotlin with the JVM. His recent experience focuses on TypeScript/Node.js and AI infrastructure, with limited Java work years ago and no demonstrated Spring ecosystem or enterprise framework knowledge. This represents a significant mismatch with the mid-senior level JVM expertise required for this role.
strengths: Demonstrated experience with IDE internals and developer tooling from National Instruments LabWindows/CVI work
Proven ability to architect and maintain complex large-scale systems and microservices infrastructure
Strong software craftsmanship practices including TDD, CI/CD, and architectural consistency across multiple languages
concerns: Minimal recent Java experience and no demonstrated Kotlin expertise despite role requirement for strong expertise in both
No evidence of Spring ecosystem or enterprise framework experience (Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate) central to the position
Current primary tech stack (TypeScript/Node.js/AI infrastructure) diverges significantly from required JVM-focused enterprise development
